title: cereus arrabidae
intro: Cereus arrabidae, commonly known as Night-blooming cereus, is a species of cactus that belongs to the genus Cereus. This plant is prized for its large, funnel-shaped flowers that bloom only at night and wilt by the morning. The health benefits of Cereus arrabidae include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality due to its sedative properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which include sedation, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
